intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Tavri is tapping two fingers on her sleeve, in time with music nobody is playing.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “I nearly gave a speech just now. About the weather. To one cloud.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “Shame. I had a whole section on drizzle.”

options.labelText: “Clouds don’t want speeches. They want someone to point and say it looks like a rabbit.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “A smug one. It definitely heard the drizzle section.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: You watch it together until it stops looking like anything.

options.labelText: “Give me the speech instead. I’ll score it out of ten.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She gives you the whole speech, including the drizzle section. It’s excellent.
